reviews.title: Ads on iPhone.
reviews.text:
There are many, many ads on the device that interfere with the App that I am attempting to use. In many cases, vital information is covered up with the ad on the information that affects the operation of the device being used.  
I am going to wait for a response from Google and Verizon before I pursue further.  
I bought the phone for communication purposes without interference from Google ads and other non-requested interruptions and I believe I have a right to expect the product and the company supplying the product to not interfere with my rights on that. 
As the owner of the device(s) I own, my right to privacy is being ignored by these actions.  
Albert ROBERTS
